label: Anchor
description: An SEP-24/SEP-31 anchor issuing or redeeming assets on/off the Stellar network on behalf of users.
typicalInfrastructure: A Horizon or RPC endpoint (self-hosted or via a third-party provider)
Deposit/withdrawal automation that watches the ledger
Compliance/KYC tooling integrated with on-chain activity
questionsToAsk: Does our ledger-watching service depend on behavior this release changes?
Have we confirmed our node/RPC provider has applied this update?
Could this affect deposit/withdrawal confirmation timing?
